title: ScopingPlan
description: ADR-025 Scoping v2 synthesis output — the proposed OPTIMAL STARTING POINT for an objective: model families/combos and the data they require, every choice carrying tier-tagged evidence citations (T3 proven-live > T2 internal experimental > T1 external). This plan is a hypothesis set for the search controller, never a verdict: the deterministic gap check (Pass C) and the full-fidelity search remain the arbiters, and a human gates any data acquisition.

run_ts.description: Scoping session run_ts this plan belongs to.

traits.description: Objective traits (asset_class / strategy_type / horizon_bucket) for warm-start keying.

kpi_sanity.description: Sanity check of the objective's KPI/requirement/target against the evidence: is the bar plausibly reachable, and what is the binding constraint?

binding_constraint.description: e.g. 'recall — precision is bought by abstention'

candidates.description: Proposed base models. Empty only in degraded/dry runs — the gap check flags an empty plan.

ensembles.description: Proposed cross-model combinations over the base candidates' OOF.

data_requirements.description: Per-plan data scope. data_classes items use the DataRequirementsSpec shape (config/data_requirements.schema.json) so the deterministic gap check consumes them directly.

open_questions.description: Unresolved items surfaced for the human gate.

reconciliation.description: Judge's note reconciling the primary synthesis with the independent replication (ADR-025 §4.6).

provenance.description: How this plan was produced (models, rounds, objection counts).

validation_flag.description: The disciplined alternative to hedging: a COMMITTED choice that carries an explicit test which would confirm or withdraw it (attach these instead of downgrading the whole choice to provisional).

check.description: The specific test that confirms or kills this committed choice, e.g. 'confirm >=300 minority samples/fold before enabling focal loss'.

withdraw_if.description: Condition under which the choice is dropped.

tier.description: Trust tier: T3 proven-live > T2 internal experimental > T1 external research.

source_ref.description: Publication id / results_index key / mlflow_run_id / journal entry ref.

id.description: Unique candidate id; defaults to family.

family.description: Model family — SHOULD exist in src/models/catalog.py; Pass C flags unknown families.

role.description: primary = signal source; gate = regime/veto filter; meta = stacker; member = ensemble-only.

commitment.description: committed = a decided starting-point choice; exploratory = an explicitly to-validate branch. A plan where EVERY candidate is exploratory is over-hedged (critic red flag over_hedging).

validation_flags.description: Explicit checks that confirm/kill this committed candidate — the disciplined alternative to marking the whole choice provisional.

params_hint.description: REQUIRED for a committed candidate: starting values AND search ranges for the load-bearing hyperparameters (capacity/depth, regularization, LR, class-weighting/sampling, sequence length, calibration), grounded in cited prior assessments/research. The search still tunes within these.

features.description: Feature-selection hint: one of view / prefixes / columns (manual_candidates shape), plus the timeframe(s) the features are computed at.

timeframe.description: Bar/sampling timeframe these features are computed at (e.g. '1s','5s','1m','5m').

by_group.description: Per-feature-group timeframe override for multi-resolution inputs, e.g. {'orderflow':'1s','macro':'1d'}.

kind.description: Combination method, e.g. consensus | vote | stacking | gate_agree | gate_veto.
